title: Padres @ Brewers
summary: Brewers have the shorter price, but the game shape still looks live because at least one of the supporting layers is pulling back toward Brewers.
lean: Lean Brewers if the cleaner starter-to-bullpen chain and standings profile still hold once the late innings start to matter.
factors: Current board: Padres +125 / Brewers -150 | O7 (+100) / U7 (-120) | Padres +1.5 (-180) / Brewers -1.5 (+150).
Jacob Misiorowski carries the cleaner starter line for Brewers, with 2.45 ERA and 70 strikeouts.
Padres enter 24-17, division leader, +1 RD; Brewers enter 23-16, 2nd in division, +56 RD.
Padres offense: 7.32 H/G with 5.67 over the last three; Brewers offense: 8.13 H/G with 7.67 over the last three.
Padres bullpen: 3.68 ERA and 1.20 WHIP; Brewers bullpen: 3.40 ERA and 1.33 WHIP.
swingFactor: Swing factor: whether Padres can keep the game live long enough to stop Misiorowski from dictating the entire pace.
